task.name: Use_camp_shower
task.why: Potable water and gray-water capacity are limited.
task.when: Every time a camp member uses the shower
task.time: 3 minutes or less of running water

step.action: Brush loose hair before entering 🔧 Camp_Shower.
Put clothes, bottles, packaging, and personal items in your bag.
Start the timer when you turn on the water.
Turn off the water while applying soap or shampoo.
Direct rinse water over soap remaining on the walls and floor.
Turn off the water before the timer reaches 3 minutes.
Put hair, wipes, and packaging in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Run 🔧 Gray-Water_Pump until the shower basin is empty.
step.ifThen: IF the pump does not remove the water or you see a leak, THEN close the shower, display 🔧 Out_of_Service_Sign, and tell the Dominatrix.

passWhen.criterion: Running-water time did not exceed 3 minutes.
No personal item, hair, trash, mud, or standing water remains.
